text:
Samir Patel: Hey everyone — I just got my MacBook from IT but FileVault shows 'Off' and Duo push keeps failing. Also got an email about a security orientation. Is the phishing test already active for new hires? Can I use my personal iPad for Slack or does that need MDM enrollment? Who should I ping for quick troubleshooting? Thanks!

Claire Nguyen: Welcome Samir! :wave: Ping @Evan Ruiz for the laptop/DUO stuff. Security orientation is assigned during your first week, phishing simulation for the new cohort usually runs the Monday after your start week, not immediately. Personal iPads: we generally avoid enrolling personal devices in MDM — use the Slack app via SSO and enable device passcode + disk encryption. See device policy: https://redwood-internal.kb/onboarding/device-policy

Evan Ruiz: Hey Samir — quick checks: run `sudo fdesetup status` and paste output. For Duo try re-registering here: https://duo.redwood.com/self-enroll. If FileVault is Off you can enable via System Prefs > Security & Privacy > FileVault or run `sudo fdesetup enable -user samir` (mac). If Duo still errors, ping me and I can remote in.

Samir Patel: fdesetup output: "FileVault is Off". Duo self-enroll says "device not found" when I try to send push.

Evan Ruiz: Got it. Let's do a 10-min remote session — what time works? Meanwhile, try: `sudo fdesetup enable -user samir` and then restart. If you prefer I can push the enroll remotely. Also confirm if this is a loaner or assigned device.

Samir Patel: It's the assigned device. 10:30am PT works for me.

Priya Kapoor: Quick security note: for personal devices used for Slack/access, you must have disk encryption enabled and a device lock. Don't copy or store customer PII on personal devices. Full-time employees should use company-managed devices when possible — we allow exceptions but they require approval. Phishing sim update: it's cohort-based; expect a test & feedback email next Wed.

training-bot: Security orientation (module: "New Hire Security Basics") assigned to Samir Patel. Due date: 2025-04-09. Link: https://training.redwood-internal/learn/nh-security-basics

Samir Patel: Thanks all — 10:30am PT confirmed. Also who should I set as my manager in the training portal? It's Jake Lee.

Claire Nguyen: Added Jake Lee as your manager for training approvals. :white_check_mark: See you at 10:30, Evan will DM the meeting link.
